body.x: High performance portable audio system with beverage/food storage combines stunning design with extraordinary audio sound qualityThomas & Darden(www.kubesound.com), the maker of portable entertainment solutions, announced "KUBE" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Kube is a premium portable audio and food/beverage storage with a elegant design and meticulously engineered function. Kube is the ultimate entertainment centerpiece and it is designed for both outdoor and indoor use.Kube features 50-foot Bluetooth range, efficient, marine certified speakers provided by Polk Audio, minimal distortion at maximum volumes, up to 20 hours of operation per charge, and a 33-quart food/beverage storage compartment.“Seeing, using, and most of all, hearing Kube, is believing in this new, game changing portable audio and entertainment experience,” said Russell Williamson, founder of Thomas & Darden. "Kube’s amazing technology and sturdy, yet beautiful design will upgrade and enliven any setting.”Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
